description: This file implements the ResourceManager plugin for a media or device management system, providing methods for controlling AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and interacting with external components via JSON-RPC. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and external API interactions.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Main class implementing the resource management plugin, handling AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and JSON-RPC communication.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Helper class for making JSON-RPC calls to other components, such as the TextToSpeech service.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set AV blocking status for an application based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve list of applications currently blocked for AV.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapperForApps
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resources for multiple applications.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resources for a single application.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets or removes an application from the AV blacklist.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list of applications currently blocked for AV.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Reserves TTS resources for a specific client.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceForApps
methods.description: Reserves TTS resources for multiple applications.
